chapter.verse: Lam khat panin, thuciamna masa in biakna ngeina ahi zongin, hih leitung tawh kipawl siangtho mun ahi zongin a nei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, puanbuk khat a kibawl hi. A masa dei sungah meivakna, sabuai leh Pasian mai-ah a kikoih khomunte a om uh hi. Hih mun in Siangtho Mun a kici hi.
A nihna puan dalna sungah Siangtho Bel Mun kici dei khat a om hi.

Tua dei sungah paknamtui halna, kham tawh a kizut thuciamna singkuangte a om uh hi. Tua singkuang sungah mana koihna kham beel tawh, a paak a paak Aaron’ ciangkhut tawh, thuciamna kigelhna suangpeekte a om uh hi.
Tua singkuang tungah vangliatna tawh kipawl vantungmi milimte in mawhphelna tokhom khuhin a om uh hi. Tua nate tu-in ka gen siang khin zo kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih na khempeuh kibawla a om ciangin, siampite in biakna bawl dingin buk masa bel ah a tum niloh uh hi.
A nihna dei sungah siampi ukpa in ama ading ahi zongin, midangte ading ahi zongin, biakna ganhing sisan paipihin, kum khatin, khatvei bek a tum hi.
A masa dei a om lai tengin Siangtho Bel Munah paina lampi a kilang nai kei hi ci-in Kha Siangtho in hih thu tawh a lak hi.
Tua dei in biakna leh piaknate tu lai tak hun ading lim ahi hi. Lungsim theihna tawh ngaihsun leng, tua biakna leh piaknate in a bia mite a kicingsak zo lo tham loin,
neek ding dawn ding, silsiang nading apawl pawlte tawh, pumpi tawh kipawl ngeinate ahi uh a, a kibawl thak hun a tun’ dongin a kip bek uh hi.

Tu-in khut tawh kibawl lo, hih leitung tawh kipawl lo, a lianzaw, a kicing zaw bukah, a nung ciangin a suak ding phattuamnate siampi ahi Khazih in eite ading a tawntung tatkhiatna thupha hong ngahsak khit ciangin, keel’ si, bawng’ si tawh hi lo, amahmah sisan tawh Siangtho Bel Mun sungah khatvei a tum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, bawng’ si, keel’ si leh bawngnuno’ kangvute in a nin mite tungah a kitheh ciangin amau pum uh a siangtho sak thei ahih uh leh,

tua tham loin, mawhna nei loin a tawntung Kha Siangtho tawh amahmah Pasian biakna-a kipia Khazih’ sisan in a nungta Pasian biak nadingin nomau pumpi kisuan’na lungsim uhah a om sihna tawh kipawl gamtatnate tawh kipelhin a siangthosak nadingin a bawl theizaw ding hilo ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin thuciamna masa hun lai takin mawhna a tatkhiat nadingin, sihna thuakna om zo ahih ciangin a sap mite in a luah tawntungna tawh kipawl thuciamna ngah nading, tua Topa in thuciamna thak khamna a suak hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sih khit ciang a, luah nading lai a kip leh, sih ciamna lai-at mi a sih phot kul ding hi.
A sih khit ciangin sih ciamna lai a kip ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sih ciamna lai-atpa a nuntak lai takin sih ciamna lai in a kip kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thuciamna masa in si tawh loin a kiciam kei hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Thukham khempeuh Moses in mi khempeuh kiangah a hilh khit ciangin tui tawh kihel bawngno’ si, keel’ si, a san tuumul leh pumpeeng ngeekte la-in Lai Siangtho ahi zongin, mi khempeuh tungah ahi zongin a theh a,
“Hih si in note kiangah Pasian hong piak thukham thuciamna si ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Biakna buk leh, a biakna nate zong tua mah bangin si tawh a theh hi.
Thukham thu bangin na khempeuh sisan tawh kisiangthosak hi cih ding ahi hi. Sisan kibua loin mawhna maisakna a om kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vantungah a om nate limte in tuate tawh a siangthosak hi. Ahih hangin vantung nate ahih uh leh, a phazawte tawh a siangthosak hi.
Tua mah bangin a siangthona mun taktak lim ahi, mi khut tawh kibawl a siangtho mun sungah Khazih tum lo hi. eite taang dingin tu-in Pasian mai-ah a pumpi a lah nadingin vantungah a tum hi.
Tua tham loin, siampi ukpa in Siangthona Mun sungah ama aa ahi lo sisan tawh kum simin a tum bang hi loin, Khazih in a pum tawh tam veipi bia kikkik ahi kei hi.
Tua banga bia hi leh, lei piancil akipan tam veipi sihna a thuak zo ta ding hi. Tu-in ahih leh, hun tawpna-ah khatvei bek a pumpi paai-in biakna tawh mawhna a paai siang dingin a kilang zo hi.
Mite in khatvei bek si-in tua nung ciangin thukhenna a thuak uh hi;
tua mah bangin Khazih in zong mi tampi mawhna puakhia dingin khatvei bek biakna sihna a thuak khit ciangin, amah a lamente gum dingin mawhna tawh kipawl loin, nih veina a hong a paikik ding hi.
